# AcaciaFund

> Research synthesis & experimental learning platform. Static-first, privacy-preserving.

AcaciaFund is a research-synthesis lab (not a fund) that scans arXiv and Hacker News, scores every piece for signal quality, and turns top results into 3-minute briefings and interactive lessons.

## Content Pillars

- **AML (Anti-Money Laundering)**: Regulatory updates, transaction monitoring, compliance patterns, financial crime analysis, SARs, KYC, beneficial ownership
- **Markets**: Market analysis, algorithmic trading, semiconductor supply chains, industry trends, financial data engineering
- **Data Engineering**: Data pipelines, orchestration, quality engineering, streaming, storage, analytics infrastructure, Kafka, Airflow, Spark

## Content Types

- **Research**: Signal-scored briefings synthesized from arXiv + HackerNews (~2-4 min reads). Each article includes SQI (Signal Quality Index), source breakdown, cross-pillar connections, and Bloom taxonomy classification.
- **Learn**: Interactive lessons with Bloom taxonomy questions (Remember through Create), flashcards, quizzes, and knowledge checks. Difficulty levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced.
- **Knowledge**: Platform guides, methodology references, glossaries, system architecture documentation.

## Publishing Schedule

- **Research articles**: Published daily, sourced automatically from arXiv API and HackerNews API
- **Learn lessons**: New lessons added weekly across all three pillars
- **Knowledge base**: Updated as needed when methodology or platform changes

## All Content Is Free

AcaciaFund is completely free and open. No paywalls, no premium tiers, no subscriptions required. All research briefings, interactive lessons, and knowledge base articles are freely accessible to everyone.

## How It Works

1. Automated scanning of arXiv and HackerNews feeds
2. Signal Quality Index (SQI) scoring for each piece (source authority, freshness, consensus, relevance)
3. Bloom taxonomy classification for learning content
4. Synthesis into 3-minute briefings with cross-pillar connections
5. Interactive learning with flashcards, quizzes, and spaced repetition

## Author

- **Leszek** — Research synthesis, content automation, platform architecture. Building automated research synthesis and experimental learning systems focused on AML compliance, financial markets, and data engineering.

## Technical Details

- Static site generated with Python (Jinja2 templates)
- No JavaScript required for core reading experience
- WCAG AA accessibility compliant
- Privacy-preserving analytics (Plausible)
- No cookies, no tracking
